svg.title: Memory read, write, and rebuild flow
svg.desc: A caller authenticates and receives readable scopes before a read tries a known structured key or uses semantic search to discover candidates. Selected hits must carry provenance and resolve to an authoritative versioned source before use. A write updates an authoritative domain record before review and optional fleet promotion, then indexes the immutable revision. A correction changes the source, commits a minimized authoritative tombstone consumed by every rebuild, verifies deletion propagation, rebuilds a fresh index, compares it with the source manifest, and atomically promotes the verified index.
